category5.design: Unusable here: the capability gate comes after DHCP and netlink initialisation, which need a network namespace, AF_NETLINK and UDP port 67; in the judge's AF_UNIX-only sandbox both builds exit before the gate. The spec keeps the exploit's command line and a match on dnsmasq's startup line so the bundle exists and says why it cannot pass.
